guideText:
What a Participant email does

A Participant's email is optional. When a signed-in @jahnelgroup.com email matches a roster Participant's email, that Participant's own rows are tagged "You" on the roster, the individual leaderboards, Award recipients on the Awards page and Participation lists; their Entrant in a Bracket (themselves, their Squad, or their team in a team Bracket) is marked "You"; and a games Competition's leaderboard marks their enrolled team "Your Team". Team standings rows are not highlighted. They can log Games, report Heats and check in. A Participant without an email is never linked. It isn't used for sign-in and grants nothing beyond those Participant writes.
